connection_pairs.system_sensory_note: James Taylor and Carole King shared the same LA session-musician network in 1970–71; Taylor played guitar on Tapestry. Both records pioneer the 'breath-pause as structural element' vocal grammar that City Pop producers would later absorb. The pair establishes the AOR origin-node cluster from which the translation chain begins.

foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_zh: 你刚才听到的这口停顿，同年在洛杉矶另一间棚里，一位女词人把它做成了副歌前的悬浮和弦。同一套语法，换了一张嘴。
foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_en: The breath-pause you just heard — in another LA studio that same year, a songwriter made it a suspended chord before the chorus. Same grammar, different mouth.

callback_named_at_to.voice_zh: 你刚才在James Taylor那里听到的那口呼吸，到了这里被做成了Cm7的悬挂。同一个停顿手势，换了和声语言。
callback_named_at_to.voice_en: The breath-pause from James Taylor just now — here it becomes a suspended Cm7. Same gesture, different harmonic language.

intrinsic_score.rationale: Concrete carrier is strong: Taylor played guitar on Tapestry, documented. Story drive is the arc-opening pair — lays the LA network foundation — but is not itself a narrative turn.

connection_pairs.system_sensory_note: No direct documented connection between Carole King and 竹内まりや; this is thematic kinship via the Cm7 harmonic-suspension vocabulary that travels through the LA chain (King → AOR template → Toto/Foster). シングル・アゲイン's pre-chorus hold is audibly descended from the It's Too Late harmonic suspension, but the lineage is mediated, not direct.

foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_zh: 这口副歌前的悬浮和弦，在洛杉矶被录进了这张唱片。十六年后，同一口气会在东京被一位女声完整内化，说成日语。
foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_en: The harmonic suspension you just heard will surface sixteen years later in Tokyo — the same breath before the chorus, now Japanese.

callback_named_at_to.voice_zh: 你刚才在Carole King那里听到的副歌前悬挂，到了竹内まりや这里已经完全内化成了母语。呼吸还在，语言换了。
callback_named_at_to.voice_en: The pre-chorus suspension from Carole King just now, fully internalized into Japanese — here in 竹内まりや. The breath is the same; the language changed.

intrinsic_score.rationale: Focus relevance is high — this is a textbook translation-aesthetic cross-tradition pair. Evidential strength is the weakest dimension: the link is thematic kinship without a paper trail, making this one of the episode's three null-edge pairs.

connection_pairs.system_sensory_note: David Paich (keyboards, Lowdown co-writer) and Jeff Porcaro (drums) recorded Silk Degrees and co-founded Toto the following year. Wikipedia and the Toto band history confirm both names on both records. This is the single best-documented personnel bridge in the first half of the episode: the coat being cut.

foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_zh: 这张专辑里的键盘手和鼓手，次年离开，用同一批人组了一支新乐队。那支乐队后来出现在了日本录音棚里。
foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_en: The keyboardist and drummer on this record left the following year to form a new band. That band later turned up in a Japanese studio.

callback_named_at_to.voice_zh: 你刚才在Boz Scaggs那张专辑里听到的键盘手和鼓手，就是现在这支乐队。同一批手，换了一个乐团的名字。
callback_named_at_to.voice_en: The keyboardist and drummer you just heard on Boz Scaggs — they are this band. Same hands, different name.

intrinsic_score.rationale: Concrete carrier maxes: named personnel (Paich, Porcaro) appear on both records, two Tier-2 sources. Story drive is high: this pair is the literal seam where the coat is sewn — the physical personnel bridge the episode's arc depends on.

connection_pairs.system_sensory_note: 山下達郎's use of jazz chord voicings as commercial pop grammar is the most-cited Steely Dan inheritance in Japanese music criticism. Multiple sources confirm the 'Japan's Steely Dan' characterisation. The evidence basis is musicological consensus with multiple Wikipedia/journalism sources.

foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_zh: 这套把爵士和弦当流行语法的录音室哲学，越过太平洋。十年后在东京，有人把它做得比这里更完整，评论家的对比还是落回到这个名字。
foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_en: Jazz chords as pop grammar crossed the Pacific. A decade later in Tokyo, someone pushed this further — critics still reached for this band's name.

callback_named_at_to.voice_zh: 你刚才在Steely Dan那里听到的爵士和弦作为流行语法，到了山下達郎这里被推到了极致。「日本的Steely Dan」这个标签，评论家不是随便叫的。
callback_named_at_to.voice_en: The Steely Dan jazz-chord grammar you just heard — here in 山下達郎 it is complete. The label 'Japan's Steely Dan' earned, not given.

intrinsic_score.rationale: Story drive is strong: the Steely Dan → 山下達郎 lineage is the most documented cross-Pacific translation in City Pop criticism. Concrete carrier is moderate — the label exists but no single sonic moment is pinned.

connection_pairs.system_sensory_note: Jeff Porcaro (drums), Steve Lukather (guitar), David Hungate (bass) appear in the liner notes of 竹内まりや's Miss M (1980), recorded at Monterrey Sound Studios, Los Angeles, produced by David Foster. Confirmed by Discogs release 5017612 and SessionDays professional archive. This is the physical moment of contact — the coat hand-stitched across the Pacific.

foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_zh: 这张专辑录完两年后，这支乐队里的三个人飞去洛杉矶，给一位日本女歌手录了一张专辑。针线从这里穿过去的。
foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_en: Two years after this record, three members of this band flew to Los Angeles and played on a Japanese artist's album. The thread passes through here.

callback_named_at_to.voice_zh: 你刚才在Toto那里听到的三个乐手，他们出现在一九八零年Miss M的liner notes里。西岸的语法就是这样进入东京录音棚的。
callback_named_at_to.voice_en: The three players from Toto you just heard appear in the liner notes of Miss M, recorded in 1980. That is how West Coast grammar entered the Tokyo studio.

intrinsic_score.rationale: Highest-scored pair in the episode. Concrete carrier maxes: named personnel confirmed by two independent Tier-2 sources (Discogs, SessionDays). Story drive maxes because this is the physical contact moment the entire episode arc rests on — translation as literal shared studio, not metaphor.

connection_pairs.system_sensory_note: 大瀧詠一 and 山下達郎 are co-alumni of the Happy End / Niagara circle. A Long Vacation (1981) and FOR YOU (1982) are consistently co-cited in Japanese music scholarship as the definitive City Pop studio records. The pair dramatises two translation paths: internal research (Otaki) vs. direct studio contact (Yamashita/Takeuchi).

foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_zh: 没有飞去洛杉矶这条路，还有另一条：把美国流行乐研究到能从内部复制。明年，同一批听众会听到另一位用的是截然不同的方法。
foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_en: There was another path besides going to Los Angeles — study the source until you can replicate it from inside. Next year, another Tokyo artist chose the opposite approach.

callback_named_at_to.voice_zh: 大瀧詠一选择的是内部研究路线。山下達郎选择的是录音室完美主义路线。两张专辑，相差一年，是City Pop两种翻译策略的对照标本。
callback_named_at_to.voice_en: 大瀧詠一 studied from within; 山下達郎 brought the studio here. Two albums, one year apart — two translation strategies side by side.

intrinsic_score.rationale: Evidential strength is high: co-alumni status, simultaneous critical recognition, Wikipedia sources. The pair's narrative value is structural contrast (two translation methods) rather than a single dramatic pivot.

connection_pairs.system_sensory_note: 中原めいこ's 1982 CBS Sony production context places Cloudyな午後 in direct stylistic lineage from the 山下達郎 studio-perfectionism strand. The connection is structural: shared production philosophy, shared label era, shared aesthetic restraint. Evidence is musicological consensus.

foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_zh: 这套把每一轨都服务于制作人耳朵的录音室声学，同年在东京被另一位歌手用到了，用得更轻，更收敛，多余的能量都蒸馏掉了。
foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_en: This studio philosophy — every track serving the producer's ear — that same year in Tokyo reached another singer, who stripped it further, distilling it down.

callback_named_at_to.voice_zh: 你刚才在山下達郎那里听到的录音室声学极致，到了这里被蒸馏了一遍：同一套语法，多余的能量去掉了，只剩一个阴天下午的感觉。
callback_named_at_to.voice_en: The studio perfectionism from 山下達郎 just now — here it is distilled once more: same grammar, excess stripped away, leaving one cloudy afternoon.

intrinsic_score.rationale: Story drive contributes: this pair leads to the anchor and frames the 'distillation' metaphor. Concrete carrier is moderate — shared label and era, but no named arranger or session to pin it to.

connection_pairs.system_sensory_note: 竹内まりや and 中原めいこ share the 1982–87 CBS Sony production ecosystem and their records share arrangers, studios, and aesthetic grammar. The thematic through-line (Carole King → Miss M → シングル・アゲイン → Cloudyな午後) is the episode's spine. The edge covers the lateral CBS Sony relationship.

foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_zh: 从洛杉矶带回来的语法在这里已经完全成熟了。后面还有一位女声，把同一批语法再蒸馏一遍，蒸馏到只剩一个下午的轮廓。
foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_en: The grammar brought back from Los Angeles is fully matured here. Ahead, another voice will distill it once more, down to just an afternoon's outline.

callback_named_at_to.voice_zh: 你刚才在竹内まりや那里听到的Carole King呼吸语法，已经完全内化成了日语。到了这里再蒸一遍，轮廓只剩这么多。
callback_named_at_to.voice_en: The Carole King breathing grammar from 竹内まりや just now, fully internalized into Japanese — here it is distilled once more. Just this much left.

intrinsic_score.rationale: Focus relevance is the dominant dimension: this pair completes the translation chain spine (LA physical contact → matured form → distillation). Concrete carrier is moderate — shared production ecosystem but no named personnel link.

connection_pairs.system_sensory_note: Fantasy (1983) and Cloudyな午後 (1982) are by the same artist. Cloudyな午後 was released one year before Fantasy; both are placed here in narrative order (Fantasy as pre-anchor buildup) rather than strict chronology. The 'distillation' story — same voice, same grammar, more energy → less energy → essence — is audible and structurally important for the anchor introduction.

foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_zh: 紧接着，同一把嗓子，但语法被精简了，多余的能量蒸馏掉，只剩轮廓本身。
foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_en: Same voice, same grammar — next, with the excess stripped away, leaving only the outline itself.

callback_named_at_to.voice_zh: 你刚才在Fantasy里听到的是同一把嗓子，略高的能量，略多的外套。这一首是蒸馏之后的样子：一样的语法，轻了一圈。
callback_named_at_to.voice_en: The Fantasy you just heard — same voice, slightly more energy, slightly more coat. This is the distilled version: same grammar, lighter.

intrinsic_score.rationale: Story drive is strong: this pair is the direct pre-anchor setup, the 'same voice, stripped down' moment before the anchor lands. Concrete carrier is solid: same artist, same year, audibly comparable vocabulary.

connection_pairs.system_sensory_note: Ginger Root (Cameron Lew) explicitly cites 中原めいこ and contemporaries as primary influences. CITY SLICKER's production is a conscious engagement with the 1982-1988 City Pop canon. The 'reverse translation' (California re-translating Tokyo's translation of California) is the episode's downward-axis narrative.

foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_zh: 这件外套穿了四十年，绕了一圈，回到加州。下面会出现一位加州人，把日本人对加州音乐的翻译再翻译回加州。
foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_en: This coat traveled forty years, looped, and came back to California — a Californian re-translating the Japanese translation of California music.

callback_named_at_to.voice_zh: 你刚才在中原めいこ那里听到的，是加州音乐经过东京之后的样子。Ginger Root在洛杉矶，把那个东京的样子再翻译了一次。外套回到了起点。
callback_named_at_to.voice_en: What you just heard in 中原めいこ — California music filtered through Tokyo. Ginger Root in Los Angeles re-translated that Tokyo version. The coat returned to its origin.

intrinsic_score.rationale: Story drive is the main contributor: the reverse-translation loop is the episode's conceptual payoff in the downward axis. Concrete carrier is moderate — explicit artist influence claim without a named sonic moment.

connection_pairs.system_sensory_note: RYUSENKEI's シティ・ミュージック (2021) directly engages the 1982-1988 City Pop canon; the album title is in Japanese. 3号线 places the City Pop urban-transit fantasy in Shenzhen, extending the translation chain to a third geography. Consensus sources confirm the lineage.

foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_zh: 外套还没有停。四十年后，另一城市的地铁线上，有一支乐队把这件外套穿上了，唱词是普通话。
foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_en: The coat keeps moving. Forty years on, on another city's metro line, a band put it on — the lyrics now in Mandarin.

callback_named_at_to.voice_zh: 你刚才在中原めいこ那里听到的外套，到了深圳这里，唱词变成了普通话，地铁线变成了三号线。语法没有变。
callback_named_at_to.voice_en: The coat from 中原めいこ just now — in Shenzhen, the lyrics shift to Mandarin, the metro line becomes Line 3. The grammar unchanged.

intrinsic_score.rationale: Focus relevance is the dominant dimension: third-generation translation (California → Tokyo → Shenzhen) is the episode's thesis made literal. Concrete carrier includes the Japanese album title as a documented lineage claim.

connection_pairs.system_sensory_note: Ginger Root (Los Angeles) and RYUSENKEI (Shenzhen) are both 2021 downward-axis nodes demonstrating that the translation aesthetic has become globally distributed. Neither knew the other; both independently reconstructed the same grammar from the same Japanese 1980s source material. The pair shows the coat is now self-replicating.

foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_zh: 加州把外套穿回来了。同年，深圳有人在做一模一样的事：同一件外套，同一批语法，唱词换成中文。翻译没有终点。
foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_en: California put the coat back on. That same year in Shenzhen, someone was doing the same thing — same coat, same grammar, lyrics now in Chinese.

callback_named_at_to.voice_zh: 你刚才在Ginger Root那里听到的是同一套语法，同一个时代，不同的地理。洛杉矶和深圳，二零二一年，两件同款外套。
callback_named_at_to.voice_en: The grammar you just heard in Ginger Root — same coat, same era, different geography. Los Angeles and Shenzhen, 2021, wearing the same thing.

intrinsic_score.rationale: Focus relevance is the main contributor: the pair proves the translation aesthetic is geographically self-replicating, which is the episode's closing thesis. Concrete carrier and evidential strength are modest — the connection is structural/conceptual, not personnel-based.

connection_pairs.system_sensory_note: 大瀧詠一's A Long Vacation production draws on the restrained vocal aesthetics of American singer-songwriter records. The James Taylor restrained-vocal sparseness is a musicologically-cited stylistic ancestor. Evidence is consensus; no direct documented quotation from Otaki citing Fire and Rain specifically. This pair illustrates the 'internal translation path' counterpoint to the physical studio-contact path.

foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_zh: 这种克制的人声与留白，越过太平洋，被一个东京制作人研究到可以从内部复制，而他从未去过洛杉矶。
foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_en: This restrained vocal sparseness crossed the Pacific, studied to replication by a Tokyo producer who never went to Los Angeles.

callback_named_at_to.voice_zh: 你刚才在James Taylor那里听到的人声克制与空白，被大瀧詠一内化成一套可以在东京独立完成的生产语法。这就是内化路线。
callback_named_at_to.voice_en: The restrained vocal space from James Taylor just now, internalized by 大瀧詠一 into a grammar he could execute in Tokyo alone. The internal-translation path.

intrinsic_score.rationale: This pair's value is structural contrast: it introduces the 'internal research' translation strategy before the 'physical studio contact' strategy (CP3/CP5) arrives. Story drive and concrete carrier are modest — no named moment or personnel to anchor it.

connection_pairs.system_sensory_note: No direct documented connection between Steely Dan and 角松敏生; the pair is thematic kinship — both deploy jazz chord language as commercial pop grammar, with 角松敏生 representing the most harmonically complex City Pop station. Backed_by_edge_id is null; evidence is musicological inference from shared vocabulary.

foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_zh: 把爵士和弦当流行语法，这条线在日本会有一个极端化的实验：有人把它推到了副歌前的和声同时属于两个调的程度。
foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_en: Jazz chords as pop grammar — in Japan this gets pushed to an extreme: a chord before the chorus that belongs to two keys at once.

callback_named_at_to.voice_zh: 你刚才在Steely Dan那里听到的爵士和弦作为流行语法，到了角松敏生这里已经是City Pop范围内的极限形态了。
callback_named_at_to.voice_en: The Steely Dan jazz-chord grammar you just heard — here in 角松敏生 it reaches its City Pop limit. The most harmonically complex station.

intrinsic_score.rationale: Focus relevance is the main contributor: this pair extends the Steely Dan harmonic-grammar translation to its City Pop extreme. One of three null-edge pairs; evidence is inference from shared vocabulary rather than documented influence.

connection_pairs.system_sensory_note: No direct documented connection between Boz Scaggs and 濱田金吾; the pair is thematic kinship via the 'nocturnal city-blues feeling' and slow-tempo pre-chorus pause. 濱田金吾's Midnight Cruisin' era production shares the Silk Degrees rhythm-section aesthetic. One of three null-edge pairs; musicological consensus, no paper trail.

foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_zh: 这种城市蓝调的夜间孤独感，在东京会被做成慢速深夜版本，副歌前的停顿像深吸一口气，而不是快速换气。
foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_en: The nocturnal city-blues feeling — in Tokyo it becomes a slow late-night version: the pre-chorus pause a deep inhale, not a quick breath.

callback_named_at_to.voice_zh: 你刚才在Boz Scaggs那里听到的城市蓝调夜间感，到了濱田金吾这里慢下来了。副歌前那口气是深吸，不是换气。城市换了，孤独感的语法没换。
callback_named_at_to.voice_en: The nocturnal city-blues from Boz Scaggs just now — here in 濱田金吾 it slows. That pre-chorus breath is a deep inhale. The city changed; the grammar of loneliness didn't.

intrinsic_score.rationale: Focus relevance is the main contributor: the 'nocturnal city-blues' translation is a secondary strand of the episode that illustrates translation as emotional-register migration, not just harmonic vocabulary migration. One of three null-edge pairs.

connection_pairs.system_sensory_note: Tapestry's soft-soul LA production aesthetic established the template that Boz Scaggs extended into blue-eyed soul on Silk Degrees. The harmonic suspension vocabulary and the 'restrained emotion over a polished rhythm section' philosophy moves directly between the two records. Map edge documents the connection.

foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_zh: 这口悬浮和弦确立了洛杉矶这套流行制作语法。五年后，同一间城市里，一位蓝调歌手把它推进了蓝眼灵魂乐，节奏更重，外套换了颜色。
foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_en: This harmonic suspension established the LA pop production grammar. Five years later, a blues singer in the same city pushed it into blue-eyed soul — same coat, heavier beat.

callback_named_at_to.voice_zh: 你刚才在Carole King那里听到的洛杉矶制作语法，到了Boz Scaggs这里加重了节奏，换进了蓝眼灵魂乐。语法延续，颜色换了。
callback_named_at_to.voice_en: The LA production grammar from Carole King just now — in Boz Scaggs it gets a heavier rhythm section and blue-eyed soul. Same grammar, different colour.

intrinsic_score.rationale: Concrete carrier and evidential strength are the main contributors: the soft-soul → blue-eyed-soul step is documented in the map edge with Wikipedia support. The pair completes the LA AOR ancestry chain before the Toto personnel pivot.

connection_pairs.system_sensory_note: Silk Degrees (1976) and Aja (1977) are the two pinnacle AOR studio records of their era, sharing the LA session-musician network and the philosophy of harmonic sophistication as commercial pop grammar. The pair represents the two-peak moment of West Coast AOR before the Toto personnel split.

foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_zh: 把复杂和弦做进流行单曲，这间城市同年还有另一支乐队把同一件事做得更学术，更冷，更彻底。
foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_en: Complex chords into pop — that same year in the same city, another band was doing the same thing more academically, more coldly, more completely.

callback_named_at_to.voice_zh: 你刚才在Boz Scaggs那里听到的把复杂和弦当流行语法的方向，到了Steely Dan这里变得更精密、更学术。同一间城市，同一条路，不同的终点。
callback_named_at_to.voice_en: The complex-chords-as-pop-grammar direction from Boz Scaggs just now — in Steely Dan it becomes more precise, more academic. Same city, same road, different destination.

intrinsic_score.rationale: Evidential strength is the main contributor: both records are co-cited peak AOR documents, map edge confirmed. Focus relevance is modest — this is same-tradition dialogue, not yet cross-cultural translation.

connection_pairs.system_sensory_note: 竹内まりや and 稲垣潤一 are both core members of the City Pop generation working in Tokyo within the same 1982-1988 window, sharing arrangers, studios, and label infrastructure. The lateral_generation edge in the map covers this entire peer group.

foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_zh: 同一批东京录音棚、同一批编曲师、同一个年代。这套语法在这代人里还有很多变体，下面会听到其中一个更商业的版本。
foreshadow_anonymous_at_from.voice_en: Same Tokyo studios, same arrangers, same decade. This grammar had many variants in this generation — ahead, a more commercial one.

callback_named_at_to.voice_zh: 你刚才在竹内まりや那里听到的是同一套语法的精致形态。到了稲垣潤一这里，同一批语法被做进了商业单曲，管乐进来了，停顿依然在。
callback_named_at_to.voice_en: What you just heard in 竹内まりや — the same grammar in a more polished form. In 稲垣潤一 it becomes a commercial single; brass section added, the pause still there.

intrinsic_score.rationale: Coverage pair for the lateral generation chain. Evidential strength is moderate — lateral_generation edge with consensus support. All four dimensions are balanced; the pair's primary function is connecting the lateral axis.

connection_pairs.system_sensory_note: 稲垣潤一 (1983) and ラ・ムー (1988) represent early and late stages of the City Pop lateral axis. The connection is structural: both deploy the pre-chorus pause as a central gesture, but 稲垣潤一's brass-section pop is a commercial peak while ラ・ムー represents the frequency-hollowing endpoint of the genre's evolution.
